snapshotNote: Signed, completed and pipeline values are labelled separately; they should not be added together.

snapshot.label: Equity funding / anchors
snapshot.note: Starcloud funding plus Symbiotec's anchor allocation, using reported equivalents.

snapshot.label: AI bond issuance in 2026
snapshot.note: A market-wide signal, not a single new transaction today.

stories.headline: Steadfast accepts KKR-backed take-private
stories.what: The Australian insurance broker agreed to be acquired, with completion targeted for December.
stories.beginner: Most of the headline premium has already been captured; chasing the remaining spread adds completion risk.

stories.headline: AI-debt supply begins to test demand
stories.what: Technology-sector credit spreads have widened as AI-related borrowing reaches a very large annual total.
stories.beginner: Strong issuers can still over-supply the bond market. Diversified bond exposure is easier to manage than one concentrated issuer.

stories.headline: India's IDBI Bank sale nears a decision
stories.what: Fairfax is reported to be a leading bidder, but the proposed timetable for consolidating its bank holdings is disputed.
stories.beginner: There is no clean beginner route while bidder status and regulatory conditions remain uncertain.

stories.headline: Starcloud funds orbital data-centre expansion
stories.what: Nvidia and Cisco Investments joined a private round that more than doubled the startup's reported valuation since March.
stories.beginner: Private orbital infrastructure is speculative and capital intensive, with no straightforward public-market entry.

stories.headline: Symbiotec secures IPO anchor allocation
stories.what: Most of the proposed Indian offering is a shareholder sale rather than new money entering the company.
stories.beginner: Separate growth capital from shareholder exits: only ₹1.50bn of this offer is new capital for the company.

stories.headline: Vista explores an Allvue sale
stories.what: Advisers are reportedly testing interest in the private-markets software and data provider.
stories.beginner: A preliminary private sale process offers no direct beginner opportunity.

stories.headline: Nvidia invests in Cloverleaf Infrastructure
stories.what: The minority investment supports US AI-data-centre sites, but the transaction value was not disclosed.
stories.beginner: An undisclosed private investment alone is not a sound reason to buy Nvidia shares.

snapshotNote: Currencies and deal stages differ, so the cards are deliberately not combined into one total.

snapshot.label: New takeover offers
snapshot.note: MPS offers for Banco BPM and Banca Generali.

snapshot.label: Debt under discussion
snapshot.note: Broadcom AI-infrastructure financing; not yet priced and potentially as large as $100bn.

snapshot.label: IPO equity offered
snapshot.note: Augmont's offer, including ₹6.20bn of newly issued shares.

stories.headline: MPS launches two takeover offers
stories.what: The bank moved for Banco BPM and Banca Generali as it seeks to counter Intesa's approach.
stories.beginner: Shareholder and regulatory interactions make this unsuitable as a simple merger trade.

stories.headline: Broadcom discusses very large AI debt package
stories.what: The reported financing could fund AI infrastructure, but terms are not confirmed or priced.
stories.beginner: Wait for actual structure and leverage implications; headline size is not an investable thesis.

stories.headline: Shein targets a Hong Kong listing
stories.what: The reported valuation is far below its 2022 peak, illustrating how public-market pricing has reset.
stories.beginner: Read the final prospectus and pricing before considering participation.

stories.headline: WSP persists with Arcadis approach
stories.what: WSP continues to pursue Arcadis despite resistance from the board and a major shareholder.
stories.stage: Contested; not yet a formal bid
stories.beginner: Opposition and uncertain bid terms leave no clear beginner opportunity.

stories.headline: JD.com offers EU remedies for Ceconomy deal
stories.what: The concessions may support regulatory clearance but could reduce the acquisition's economics.
stories.beginner: Regulatory remedies can change value after a deal is signed, so avoid treating approval as automatic.

stories.headline: Augmont opens its IPO
stories.what: The offer includes both new capital and shares sold by existing holders.
stories.beginner: Anchor demand does not guarantee a listing gain; focus on valuation and use of proceeds.

stories.headline: Long US Treasury yield remains elevated
stories.what: Expensive long-term funding keeps pressure on leveraged acquisitions and refinancing borrowers.
stories.beginner: Highly indebted companies and long-duration bonds are more exposed when yields stay high.

snapshotNote: The $66.8bn utility merger was previously announced and is excluded from today's new-deal total.

snapshot.label: New M&A reported
snapshot.note: Stripe's proposed OpenRouter acquisition; price reported rather than officially disclosed.

snapshot.label: Priced debt
snapshot.note: Nebius converts, Alphabet's Australian-dollar bond and OCBC covered bonds.

snapshot.label: Equity issuance
snapshot.note: Unitree's IPO proceeds before its exceptional first-day share-price move.

stories.headline: Stripe agrees its largest acquisition
stories.what: Stripe will acquire AI-model gateway OpenRouter, reportedly mainly using Stripe shares.
stories.beginner: Both companies are private, so there is no simple direct exposure.

stories.headline: Nebius upsizes convertible financing
stories.what: Two convert tranches combine low coupons with future equity-conversion and dilution risk.
stories.beginner: Convertibles mix bond and equity risks; a diversified technology fund is easier to understand.

stories.headline: Alphabet draws heavy Australian demand
stories.what: Its inaugural Kangaroo bond was more than three times covered across four maturities.
stories.beginner: Long-dated bonds can still lose value when yields rise, even for strong issuers.

stories.headline: Unitree IPO opens with extreme volatility
stories.what: Limited float and exceptional demand pushed the robotics company's shares far above the offer price.
stories.beginner: Do not chase a first-day spike; the price move reflects scarcity and speculation as well as fundamentals.

stories.headline: NextEra–Dominion merger faces wider opposition
stories.what: Maine's governor added competition concerns to the regulatory scrutiny around the utility combination.
stories.beginner: Even signed mega-deals can be delayed or repriced by regulatory opposition.

stories.headline: OCBC issues sterling covered bonds
stories.what: The Singapore bank tapped UK investors with debt backed by a designated asset pool.
stories.beginner: Covered bonds add asset backing, but diversified bond funds still reduce issuer and currency concentration.

stories.headline: Private-credit lenders take control of MBS Group
stories.what: HPS and Oaktree are converting debt into equity after a default and adding liquidity to stabilise the business.
stories.number: Hundreds of millions converted; $40m new funding
stories.beginner: Debt-to-equity restructurings are complex and illiquid, with no clear beginner entry.

snapshotNote: Dangote's prospective $5bn IPO is pipeline and kept outside completed equity totals.

snapshot.label: Announced / proposed M&A
snapshot.note: Weave, EQT Holdings and Goldman's LCN acquisition.

snapshot.label: Completed equity sales
snapshot.note: Lyntris IPO plus Dangote's completed private placement.

stories.headline: Long-term US borrowing costs hit a near-20-year high
stories.what: The higher risk-free rate raises refinancing costs and can delay leveraged deals and infrastructure financings.
stories.beginner: Use the move to understand why long-duration bonds fall and heavily leveraged companies become riskier.

stories.headline: Dangote Refinery advances IPO preparation
stories.what: An underwriting programme combines a completed private placement with capital linked to the planned listing.
stories.beginner: Wait for the prospectus, governance and valuation; emerging-market and commodity exposure add complexity.

stories.headline: Indian banks accelerate offshore borrowing
stories.what: ICICI tightened pricing after strong demand while four peers prepared further dollar issuance.
stories.beginner: A diversified bond fund is simpler than individual offshore bank notes, though currency and credit risk remain.

stories.headline: Lyntris prices a smaller IPO below expectations
stories.what: The defence contractor sold fewer shares and below its earlier marketing range.
stories.beginner: Downsizing signals price sensitivity; a diversified defence fund avoids new-listing concentration.

stories.headline: Francisco Partners agrees to acquire Weave
stories.what: The all-cash transaction offers a sizeable premium and is expected to close in the fourth quarter.
stories.beginner: The remaining merger spread comes with completion risk; do not treat it as guaranteed return.

stories.headline: TPG approaches EQT Holdings
stories.what: The Australian trustee company received a conditional proposal that still requires due diligence.
stories.beginner: Litigation, regulation and due diligence make this a speculative takeover situation.

stories.headline: Goldman expands private real estate with LCN
stories.what: The purchase adds a roughly $3bn property platform, with most consideration paid in Goldman shares.
stories.beginner: Broad financial-sector exposure is simpler than judging one acquisition's integration economics.

snapshotNote: Proposed M&A, issuance and restructuring figures represent different transaction types and are not summed.

snapshot.label: Proposed / announced M&A
snapshot.note: Reliance Worldwide plus Deutsche Telekom's Polish fibre acquisition.

snapshot.label: Public equity issuance
snapshot.note: Two SPAC IPOs priced at $10 per unit.

stories.headline: Brookfield targets Reliance Worldwide
stories.what: The proposal values the business at 12.1× FY26 adjusted EBITDA but remains non-binding.
stories.beginner: Avoid chasing the shares near the offer price; limited upside remains while completion risk persists.

stories.headline: Deutsche Telekom expands in Poland
stories.what: The acquisition adds fibre infrastructure passing 1.4 million homes and more than 300,000 customers.
stories.beginner: Diversified telecom or infrastructure exposure is simpler than trading a single acquisition.

stories.headline: General Atlantic revives its IPO plan
stories.what: JPMorgan was reportedly selected as lead underwriter alongside Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs.
stories.beginner: Wait for valuation and disclosures; reputation alone is not an investment case.

stories.headline: Foundever completes a major recapitalisation
stories.what: The transaction reduces debt, adds common equity and extends major maturities to 2030–2031.
stories.beginner: The company is private and distressed investing is too complex for a straightforward beginner position.

stories.headline: Bunge prices new senior notes
stories.what: Proceeds may be used for refinancing and other corporate purposes.
stories.beginner: A diversified corporate-bond fund lowers single-issuer risk, though rate and credit risks remain.

stories.headline: Two SPAC IPOs raise $300m
stories.what: Karman Line and NorthStrive listed blank-cheque vehicles with aerospace, defence and industrial themes.
stories.beginner: Warrants, dilution and uncertain future acquisitions make blank-cheque companies unsuitable as a safe starting point.

stories.headline: Barclays changes investment-bank leadership
stories.what: Mike Joo will join Adeel Khan as co-CEO from February 2027 as Barclays seeks stronger investment-bank revenue.
stories.beginner: A senior appointment alone is not enough evidence to buy a bank stock.
